description: Reference tool: Discover credit unions by state or nearest to a 5-digit ZIP. State listings include rate availability, member count, and reported location count. ZIP discovery ranks NCUA-reported branches by estimated straight-line miles from the ZIP center. For personalized rate recommendations, use get_financing_decision instead.

state.description: Optional: Filter to a specific state (2-letter code). If not provided, returns all states.

zip.description: Optional: Find the closest credit unions by NCUA-reported branch location. Distances are ZIP-centroid straight-line estimates. When supplied, ZIP discovery takes precedence over state listing.

name: list_credit_unions

credit_unions.description: The credit unions in this state, alphabetical by name.

has_rates.description: True when this credit union has published rates on file; false means it is known but nothing is currently quotable.

last_verified.description: UTC timestamp when rates were last successfully scraped. Null means never successfully scraped.

location_count.description: Number of NCUA-reported branch locations. 0 can mean genuinely branchless or simply not reported.

members.description: Member count from the NCUA quarterly call report. Null when no NCUA profile is linked.

name.description: Credit union name as displayed, usually without the words 'Credit Union'.

product_count.description: Number of distinct rate products currently on file. 0 when has_rates is false.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier used in rateapi.dev links and as the `slug` argument to get_credit_union.

state.description: Lower-cased two-letter state code the listing is scoped to.

summary.description: One-sentence plain-English summary of this result, safe to quote directly to the user.

total_credit_unions.description: Number of credit unions known in this state, including those with no published rates.

verified_last_7_days.description: How many have had their rates re-scraped and confirmed in the past 7 days; the rest may be staler.

with_rates.description: How many of those credit unions currently have published rate data — always smaller than total_credit_unions.
